patterns.note: A full-bleed hero image dominates the initial viewport, which then transitions to a dense, uniform product grid that fills the remaining page content.
Consistent use of a single sans-serif font across all text elements, with navigation and labels presented in uppercase, and a large, centered brand mark in the hero section.

A stark, high-contrast monochrome palette of black, white, and various shades of light grey creates a sophisticated and minimal aesthetic, with product photography providing the primary color accents.

A fixed header persists at the top of the viewport, while the entire hero section, including its large background image and centered brand mark, scrolls completely out of view to reveal the product catalog below.

technique_notes: The header is fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining navigation access as the user scrolls down the page.

The initial hero section occupies the full viewport height, featuring a large background image and centered text. As the user scrolls, this entire hero section moves upwards with the page content, eventually disappearing from view to reveal the product grid below.

design_tokens.type_scale: A clear hierarchy with a very large, centered brand mark in the hero (~4-5x body text) and small, uppercase navigation/labels, all using a consistent sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used throughout, with no visible rounding on any elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy in the hero section, transitioning to a dense, uniform grid with consistent padding for product items.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-bleed, high-contrast, almost art-house black-and-white hero image that completely scrolls away, coupled with a minimal, stark aesthetic, creates a strong sense of exclusive, high-fashion editorialism rather than a typical e-commerce storefront.
